items.title: 52043_Herman Autrey oral history interview
items.q: And Jeff -- what was Jeff's last name -- on piano.

ctx.x: Naw, no, no. He was fair. He's -- I don't know. He owned the horn, I would say, you know. (Laughs.) And Jeff -- what was Jeff's last name -- on piano. He smoked a big cigar like -- let's see, who died? The man? Willie Willard the Lion, yeah, but he was -- I'm trying to think who was the drummer.
How long did you go on playing both the club and the Howard?
